quests.title: Apes Who Forgot to Share
quests.text: Past the Shattered Line the jungle grows glass: The Skyglass Canopy. Glass-Knuckle Jungle Apes rule the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood} by day {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}. Kill five; the canopy spirits say the apes forgot whose fruit it was.

quests.title: A Sharp Beat for the Drum
quests.text: At night Glass-Shadow Panthers hunt the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood} {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/cloudwood}. Kill four and bring two Glass Cat Claws for the shrine drum; the drum likes a sharp beat.

quests.title: Glass-Fang Serpents
quests.text: Glass-Fang Serpents coil through the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} by day {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}. Kill five and bring two Glass Venom. The shrine pays the canopy back for everything it takes, and venom is how the canopy wants it paid.

quests.title: Paymaster Chirr
quests.text: Paymaster Chirr keeps the Last-Pay Archers loyal with promises from the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}. Kill four archers at the camp, then Chirr. A promise without a paymaster is just wind in the leaves.

quests.title: Group: Serpent Glass-Throat
quests.text: Serpent Glass-Throat coils deep in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. No single fighter swallows that one; bring a group, and the shrine sings for all of you.

quests.title: Bounty: High Canopy Panthers
quests.text: Glass-Shadow Panthers return to the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} every night {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}. Kill five and the shrine pays. Come back twenty minutes after you collect, and it pays again.
